name: rust metal
desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Non magical ammunition made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed after dealing damage.
